# Flagcn

> Flagcn is a shadcn registry for 306 accessible React flags plus country, phone, language, and currency components. It copies editable source into a project and has no Flagcn runtime package.

## Start here

- [Complete agent reference](/llms-full.txt): Full API, installation, accessibility, and licensing contract.
- [Agent instructions](/AGENTS.md): Safe defaults for coding agents modifying a consumer project.
- [Registry index](/r/registry.json): Exact shadcn registry items and stable names.
- [OpenAPI description](/openapi.json): Registry endpoint contract.
- [API catalog](/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 service discovery.
- [Documentation](/docs): Human-readable guides.
- [Flag catalog](/flags): Search and preview every format and ratio.

## Install

`@flagcn` is listed in the official shadcn Registry Directory, so current shadcn CLI releases resolve it without a local `components.json` registry entry.

```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @flagcn/flag
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @flagcn/flag-picker
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @flagcn/country-picker
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @flagcn/phone-input
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @flagcn/language-picker
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @flagcn/currency-picker
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @flagcn/ae
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @flagcn/all
```

## Search and discovery

```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest view @flagcn/ae
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest search @flagcn -q "United Arab Emirates"
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest list @flagcn
```

## API summary

`Flag` accepts `code`, `alt`, `format` (`svg | png | webp | jpg`), `width`, `ratio` (`4x3 | 1x1 | original`), `decorative`, `className`, `style`, `ref`, and standard React image props. Defaults are SVG, width 80, ratio 4:3, lazy loading, and async decoding. The 4:3 and 1:1 frames use contain behavior so artwork is never clipped.

`FlagPicker` supports controlled or uncontrolled selection, native/alias/ISO/calling-code search, keyboard operation, `format`, `ratio`, `codes`, `disabledCodes`, flag-kind filtering, optional calling-code labels, an accessible name through `aria-label`, and a hidden form field through `name`.

Country features include `CountryPicker`, native `CountrySelect`, `CountryBadge`, `FlagAvatar`, `PhoneInput`, typed country data, reversible country/emoji helpers, shared calling-code-safe array lookups, and current GCC/EU collections.

Locale features include searchable `LanguagePicker` and `CurrencyPicker`, RTL language metadata, currency metadata, and Intl-backed `CurrencyValue` formatting.

`@flagcn/<code>` installs one typed wrapper. `@flagcn/all` installs every Flagcn component, utility, collection, typed data file, and all 306 wrappers.

## Website behavior

The homepage, catalog shell, and documentation render immediately. Flag galleries and native `img` assets load progressively without replacing the whole page. Catalog cards expose an icon-only install-command copy action in the preview corner, then compact JSX copy, image copy, and fetched-file download actions in the footer. Documentation examples expose their exact JSX through a per-example `View Code` control, and route changes reset the document scroll position unless the destination contains an explicit hash.

## Rights

Flagcn original source is MIT licensed. SVG artwork uses Flag Icons 7.5.0 under MIT. Raster artwork, U.S. state SVGs, and original-proportion SVGs use FlagCDN; Flagpedia documents its artwork as public domain. See [license documentation](/docs/license), [Flag Icons](https://flagicons.lipis.dev/), and [Flagpedia's statement](https://flagpedia.net/about).
